# Project Phoenix v58.0 — Pan-Eurasian Silk Road & Maritime Spice Corridor (1337-1780).
# Native EU5 1.4.9 Interactive Situation (`is_data_map = yes`, live 0..100 meters `oe_v58_sr_flow_index` & `oe_v58_sr_maritime_share`).

oe_sit_v58_silk_road_spice_corridor = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	hint_tag = hint_oe_sit_v58_silk_road_spice_corridor

	can_start = {
		current_year >= 1337
		current_year <= 1780
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v58_sr_ended }
		OR = {
			location:constantinople = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { is_rebel_country = no } }
			location:alexandria = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { is_rebel_country = no } }
			location:tabriz = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { is_rebel_country = no } }

			location:jinjiang = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { is_rebel_country = no } }
		}
	}

	visible = {
		current_year >= 1337
		current_year <= 1785
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			is_great_power = yes
			has_variable = oe_v58_sr_participant
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					sub_continent = sub_continent:middle_east

					sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
					sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
					sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia
					sub_continent = sub_continent:east_africa
					region = region:balkan_region
					region = region:italy_region
					region = region:iberia_region
					region = region:steppes_region
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Pan-Eurasian Golden Commercial Equilibrium (flow_index >= 85)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v58_sr_out_eurasian_golden_web"
		desc = "oe_v58_sr_out_eurasian_golden_web_desc"
		trigger = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v58_sr_flow_index }
				var:oe_v58_sr_flow_index >= 85
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v58_sr_ended value = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v58_sr_participant
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 12
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v58_sr_mod_golden_web_legacy years = 30 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Oceanic Spice Hegemony (Cape & Monsoon sea-lanes eclipse overland caravans after 1650)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v58_sr_out_oceanic_hegemony"
		desc = "oe_v58_sr_out_oceanic_hegemony_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1650
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v58_sr_maritime_share }
				var:oe_v58_sr_maritime_share >= 75

			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v58_sr_ended value = 2 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no

					OR = {

						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v58_sr_participant

				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v58_sr_mod_oceanic_monopoly_legacy years = 25 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Twilight of the Old Corridors (1780 historical horizon)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v58_sr_out_corridor_transition"
		desc = "oe_v58_sr_out_corridor_transition_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1780

		immediate = {

			}
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_v58_sr_started value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v58_sr_flow_index value = 45 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v58_sr_maritime_share value = 40 }
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v58_sr_flow_index } } set_variable = { name = oe_v58_sr_flow_index value = 45 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v58_sr_maritime_share } } set_variable = { name = oe_v58_sr_maritime_share value = 40 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1500
				var:oe_v58_sr_maritime_share < 72
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v58_sr_maritime_share add = 0.08 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v58_sr_flow_index < 78
				any_country = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						has_country_modifier = oe_v58_sr_mod_caravan_escort
						has_country_modifier = oe_v58_sr_mod_monsoon_fleet
						has_country_modifier = oe_v58_sr_mod_silver_silk
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v58_sr_flow_index add = 0.15 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v58_sr_flow_index > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v58_sr_flow_index value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v58_sr_flow_index < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v58_sr_flow_index value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v58_sr_maritime_share > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v58_sr_maritime_share value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v58_sr_maritime_share < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v58_sr_maritime_share value = 0 } }
	}

		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v58_sr_ended } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v58_sr_ended value = 3 }
		}
	}
